system_instruction: For this fictional respondent exercise, answer as the person described. Use the supplied background facts. Answer the question with YES or NO only.
background: This is an invented teaching example. A retailer offers an optional free shopping assistant. It suggests products using your purchase history and saves time when making a shopping list. The retailer stores the history for 12 months. You may delete it and turn the assistant off. The retailer does not sell this history to other companies.

questions.A: Would the shopping assistant make planning your shopping more convenient?
questions.B: Would you be comfortable with the retailer storing this purchase history for 12 months?
questions.F: Would you choose to enable this shopping assistant?
